DDInter574.mechanism: The use of monomethyl fumarate (MMF) or its prodrugs, dimethyl fumarate and diroximel fumarate, with other immunosuppressive or myelosuppressive agents may increase the risk of infections.

DDInter596.mechanism: INTERVAL: Coadministration with dexrazoxane may diminish the therapeutic response to doxorubicin. Since both are topoisomerase inhibitors, it is possible that dexrazoxane may interfere with the anti-tumor effects of doxorubicin.
